description: This file defines an extension for the Process class in Swift, adding a method to run a process and read data from a pipe safely until completion to avoid blocking.

methods.name: runAndReadToEnd(from:)
methods.description: Runs the process, reads all data from the specified pipe without blocking, waits for the process to exit, and returns the collected data.

parameters.name: pipe
parameters.description: The pipe from which to read data.
